BL-1847 — On a pack that declares config coordinator_mode deterministic, handoffd relays every parcel that reaches the coordinator's new mail to the human's Telegram OPERATOR topic, one message per tick, then completes it unchanged - so nothing waits for a coordinator model that is not there and nothing is dropped, and the ticket close guard still reads QA's approval
